acceptance_criteria.statement: An approve_independent review from rizzstack-reviewer[bot] satisfies independent_review at the head.
An approve_independent review from the owner login satisfies independent_review at the head.
The same body from any other login is not an approval.
A review record with no user login is not an approval.
review_identity_ok accepts exactly the reviewer app and owner logins and refuses an empty record.
review_form still reports changes_requested for a rejection posted by any login.

observable_behavior: the reviewer app login is accepted
any other login is not an approval
a rejection from any login still governs
outcome.summary: The vendored gate checks the review's author login: an approve_independent attestation counts only from rizzstack-reviewer[bot] or the owner's login. A rejection still governs whatever account posted it. The six repos are re-vendored byte-identically after this lands.

title: Gate accepts independent approvals only from the reviewer app or owner
